resume.name: Mustafa Shaikh
education: KLE Technological University | B.E. Computer Science & Engineering | CGPA: 9.2/10 (2024 – 2028 Expected)
projects: Video Sharing & Microblogging Network – Built and deployed a full-stack MERN media platform with video streaming, microblogging, and user subscriptions. Engineered a REST API (Node.js, Express) with MongoDB aggregation pipelines for subscriber counts and watch history. Built a React + Vite frontend using React Query for server-state caching and Zustand for auth state. Integrated Multer and Cloudinary for uploads; containerized with Docker and deployed on Render.

Distributed CI/CD Pipeline Orchestrator & Execution Engine – Architected a distributed CI/CD orchestrator that models build/test/deploy workflows as Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) with dynamic dependency resolution. Built a resource-aware scheduler matching task CPU/RAM needs to live runner capacity to prevent host starvation. Ran tasks in isolated Docker runners with CPU/memory quotas and shared-volume caching for artifact passing. Streamed live container logs to a React dashboard in real time via WebSockets (Socket.io). Designed fault tolerance with a 10s heartbeat protocol that detects dead runners and reschedules their stranded tasks automatically. Added GitOps automation with GitHub Webhooks and OAuth, parsing YAML pipeline configs to trigger containerized builds on every push.
